faqs.q: What exactly do I get with the Premium Pass?
faqs.a: Unlimited access to every mock test on Mock Matrix Hub — full-length, sectional and subject-wise — plus the complete 25000+ PYQ library, sectional timers, unlimited attempts, live all-India rankings, detailed analytics and the private Telegram group. Future exam mocks unlock for you first.

faqs.q: How long is my Premium valid?
faqs.a: You pick at checkout: 1 Month (30 days), 6 Months (180 days) or 1 Year (365 days). Your Premium stays active for exactly the validity of the plan you choose — one payment, no auto-renewal, no hidden charges.

faqs.q: How fast is my access activated after payment?
faqs.a: Instantly. The moment Razorpay confirms your payment, your profile flips to Premium automatically — usually within a few seconds. No codes to enter, no waiting for email approval.
UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), all debit/credit cards, netbanking and popular wallets — processed securely by Razorpay over a 256-bit encrypted connection. We never see or store your card details.

faqs.q: Can I attempt a mock test more than once?
faqs.a: Yes — unlimited attempts on every mock for the whole year of your validity. Re-attempts are the fastest way to fix mistakes, so we never cap them.
If Premium isn't what you expected, write to support within 7 days of purchase and we refund the full amount — no questions asked. After 7 days, refunds follow the standard refund policy.

faqs.q: Do I need to pay again when new mocks are added?
faqs.a: Never. Every mock, PYQ set and sectional added during your validity is included automatically — including future exam mocks, which Premium members get first access to.

faqs.q: Can I use Premium on multiple devices?
faqs.a: Yes — login with the same account on phone, tablet or desktop. Your attempts, analysis and rankings stay in sync across all of them.
Enter your coupon on the checkout step and the discounted price updates instantly before you pay. Partner and referral coupons are applied exactly as issued — case sensitive, as stored.
